faqs.question: What certifications and quality approvals does Apex Precision Machinery maintain?
faqs.answer: Apex Precision Machinery holds active ISO 230-2, CE-MD (2006/42/EC), ISO 9001:2015, UL 508A certifications with verified third-party laboratory test reports.

faqs.question: What is the standard production lead time and MOQ for wholesale export orders?
faqs.answer: Standard MOQ is 1 unit. Pre-production samples dispatch within 7–10 days, and full container loads ship within 25–30 days.

faqs.question: Does your factory support private label OEM and custom tooling?
faqs.answer: Yes, we support comprehensive OEM/ODM engineering including custom mold fabrication, laser branding, and FSC retail packaging.

faqs.question: How are international shipping containers packaged to prevent transit damage?
faqs.answer: All export goods are packed on heat-treated Euro/US pallets, vacuum wrapped in dual PE moisture-barrier film, with heavy-duty corner protection.

faqs.question: What is your corporate policy regarding payment terms and wire transfers?
faqs.answer: Wires are accepted solely into official corporate bank accounts under the exact company name. Any modification requires mandatory telephone/video confirmation.

faqs.question: Can commercial buyers request physical sample demonstration kits?
faqs.answer: Yes, qualified procurement managers and architects can request a complimentary express sample box dispatched via DHL Express.
